events.title: Major DEMO Update
events.summary: Hi there!I've released a new demo version. This includes the following stage:Prelude (Act 1, Level 1)Happy Bouncy (Act 1, Level 2)Purr Bass (Act 2, Level 1)Hormones (Act 2, Level 2)For Elise - Beathoven (Act 2, Level 3, Boss)Expected time is 15-30- minutes, depending on your skill level. Try it out, and let me know what you think!Cheers!-Mislav

events.title: Open Playtest is now LIVE!
events.summary: Hi there! The last phase of playtesting is now open to everyone. The next version will be a fully featured Demo and it will be released next month. Until then, please enjoy these 2 stages:1) Prelude in C - by Drum n' Bach2) Canon in D - by Pachebells-Mislav

events.title: Open Playtest Postponed
events.summary: Hi there! A small update on Steam Playtest feature. Early playtesting revealed few important bugs with important gameplay features. These bug fixes and mechanics adjustments are taking a bit longer than initially planned. Open Playtest will be postponed a bit.Before open playtest, as soon as current bugs are fixed, everyone who is signed up for playtest (at that moment) will be given access to closed playtest. That should happen this week!Wishlist and follow the game so you receive news as soon as it's published! events.title: Beathoven Boss Update!
events.summary: Beathoven is the boss you'll see in the Demo!After careful consideration, I've decided to make the Beathoven the 1st boss for the demo. Boss stages are pushing the technical limitations of game mechanics to the limit and Beathoven fits perfectly for the 1st boss encounter!Playtest is coming ever closer! Follow to secure your slot!

events.title: 700 Wishlists in 1st month!
events.summary: Thank you!It's almost been a month since Jancer's reveal announcement and we've reached 700 wishlists!Just imagine if we were all in the same room! Hundreds of people gathered in same place! Even Elise is excited and sends her thanks! Spread the word! Show Jancer to your friends! Share the joy and excitement! :)
